title: A Study on BMS-986177 for the Prevention of a Stroke in Patients Receiving Aspirin and Clopidogrel

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this clinical study is to determine whether the addition of an oral Factor XIa Inhibitor to Aspirin and Clopidogrel is more effective than standard therapy in secondary stroke prevention.

Posted outcomes: Percent of Participants With Model Based Assessment of Composite of New Ischemic Stroke During Treatment and New Covert Brain Infarction (FLAIR + DWI) Detected . timeframe=From randomization to up to 90 days after randomization. Placebo=16.8; Milvexian 25 mg QD=16.7; Milvexian 25 mg BID=16.6
